column1: # corpus-census-rust.tsv — the PINNED rust census roster.  SOUNDNESS R663.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS.  R662 measured what a month of soundness work changed for a user, over
# "1,626 crates" — which were not a corpus at all, but whatever `cargo` happened to have
# downloaded into this laptop's registry cache.  Nothing owned it, nothing pinned it, and it does
# not exist on the second machine, so THE HEADLINE MEASUREMENT OF THE PROJECT WAS UNREPEATABLE.
# An instrument whose input is an accident produces a number nobody can check.
# This is NOT the oracle roster in corpus.sh.  That one is four checkouts chosen for the SHAPES
# they expose (see its comments — sqlite-jdbc is there for one filter, axios for one .d.ts case).
# This one is chosen for SCALE, so a percentage has a denominator.  Keep both; they answer
# different questions and a census over four curated projects would be worthless.
# name<TAB>version.  Acquire with: bash bin/corpus-census.sh rust
# Snapshotted 2026-09-25 from the registry that produced R662, so that census is reproducible.
